# Leave The Key Homebuyers

> > Leave The Key Homebuyers provides fast cash home buying services across New York and Long Island, specializing in as-is sales, quick closings, and no-commission transactions for homeowners facing relocation, downsizing, or property challenges.

Founded by Larry Wagner and team, Leave The Key Homebuyers serves Long Island communities including Bay Shore, Brookhaven, Sayville, Great Neck, and surrounding New York areas. The company offers direct cash purchases with quick closings, eliminating agent fees and repair requirements for sellers in various situations.
